codes.name: Ratio Additive Interpretation
codes.description: Treating multiplicative ratio relationship as an additive difference between quantities.

codes.name: Ratio Reversal
codes.description: Reversing terms in a ratio or allocating shares to the wrong party.

codes.name: Whole to Part Confusion
codes.description: Confusing part-to-part ratio with part-to-whole fraction.

codes.name: Unit Rate Error
codes.description: Dividing total directly by a single ratio term instead of the sum of parts.

codes.name: Scale Direction Error
codes.description: Multiplying instead of dividing (or vice versa) when scaling map or model measurements.

codes.name: Unit Conversion Error
codes.description: Failing to convert measurement units before comparing or calculating ratio.

codes.name: Arithmetic Error After Correct Setup
codes.description: Executing calculation incorrectly despite having formulated the correct ratio setup.

codes.name: Irrelevant Operation
codes.description: Performing unrelated arithmetic operations on numbers present in the problem.

codes.name: Diagram Misread
codes.description: Extracting incorrect numeric values or relationships from visual diagram.

codes.name: Premature Rounding
codes.description: Rounding intermediate steps leading to inaccurate final quantity.

codes.name: Incomplete Reasoning
codes.description: Stopping after calculating unit part without completing the final share calculation.

codes.name: Answer Guessing
codes.description: Entering ungrounded numbers without demonstrable mathematical reasoning.

codes.name: Insufficient Evidence
codes.description: Student input provides insufficient numeric or structured working to classify a specific error.
